name: @pdpp/collector-runtime
description: Generic connector-execution runtime for PDPP local (device-side) collection: the collector loop, device-exporter ingest client, durable outbox, and runtime-capabilities placement gate. Depends on @pdpp/connector-protocol for the connector authoring contract (wire-protocol types, JSONL primitives). Connector-agnostic — carries no connector definitions or content.

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check && pnpm check:noUnnecessaryConditions-expiry && pnpm test
